fields.summary: Checkout page times out when the cart has more than 50 items
fields.description: Since Monday the checkout request takes over 30 s for large carts and the load balancer returns 504.

fields.summary: Add CSV export to the monthly usage report
fields.description: Finance wants to download the monthly usage report as CSV instead of copying the table.

fields.summary: Upgrade the Postgres driver to the latest minor version
fields.description: Routine dependency upgrade; no behaviour change expected.

fields.summary: Payments API returning 503 for all customers
fields.description: Every payment attempt fails since 08:05 UTC. Status page updated; incident channel opened.

fields.summary: Rotate the API keys that were committed to the deploy scripts repository
fields.description: A secret scanner flagged two API keys in the history of the deploy scripts repository.

fields.summary: Dark mode for the admin dashboard
fields.description: Several admins asked for a dark theme; follow the existing design tokens.

fields.summary: Nightly Jira ingestion job has not run for two days
fields.description: The scheduler shows no runs since Tuesday; dashboards are stale.

fields.summary: Remove the feature flag for the new onboarding flow
fields.description: The new onboarding flow has been at 100 % for a month; delete the flag and the old code path.

fields.summary: Search results ignore the selected date range
fields.description: Filtering by date range in the issue search returns results outside the range.

fields.summary: Single sign-on with the corporate identity provider
fields.description: Replace the local passwords of the admin dashboard with OpenID Connect login.

fields.summary: Document the release process in the repository
fields.description: The release steps live in a wiki page that is out of date; move them next to the code.

fields.summary: Rate limit the public status endpoint
fields.description: The status endpoint is called thousands of times a minute by a misconfigured client.
